prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Original medieval RPG LOW-RES PIXEL ART character review board, plain uniform medium grey opaque background. Each row has the SAME adult character in FRONT-LEFT and BACK-RIGHT oblique full-body views. Different rows are different people, isolated without interacting. Compact stocky 40-logical-pixel-like game sprite proportions, visibly chunky square pixel clusters, selective dark outlines, restrained earthy wool/leather colors, very simple faces and folds, no painterly shading or smooth gradients. Match the previously viewed character reference in clarity but use coarser pixels. All clothing, hair, exact age and unconfirmed gender choices are NONCANONICAL appearance proposals. No labels, text, numbers, borders, insignia, modern medical symbols, modern clothes, magic, scenario or quest resolution. No implied payment, agreement, forced movement, political endorsement or relationship reconciliation. Exact grid/palette/pivots/runtime remain unverified.  Clothes should use medieval simple round-neck or tie-neck wool cuts, NOT modern lapels, tailored suit coats or collared shirts. THREE rows TWO columns. TOP TANSER adult male injured outpost worker, mature dark hair and stubble, plain brown wool work tunic, dark trousers and worn boots; seated on a backless stool with one leg cautiously held forward, hands resting at knees, visibly protective painful posture. Source establishes LEG injury but NOT its side or specific diagnosis; no gore, no amputation, no exact wound, no invented scar, no medical cross, no healed standing pose. BOTTOM two rows each separate woman: MIDDLE VIKO adult temporary resident needing care, proposed short dark hair, faded blue-grey dress and cream shoulder shawl, upright seated on a separate simple stool holding one EMPTY plain wooden bowl, alert calm posture, no invented injury/diagnosis. BOTTOM ILE adult woman host grieving a lost family member, grey-streaked hair beneath brown headscarf, muted moss dress and dull russet apron, standing holding a different small ordinary empty bowl; tired composed expression, not priest or cult leader. No forced prayer, family replacement, forgiveness, relocation or boat; TANSER remains a separate character study, not present in the hosts second scene.
